name: documented-skill-contract
description: Filters an exported field set down to deployable fields, detects live-type drift against a declared schema, and builds raw Field XML for column types a typed field-creation API cannot express (Calculated -- no -Formula parameter exists; Lookup/LookupMulti; User/UserMulti). Pure planning; no write ships in this module.
prompt: Use the provision-fields skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
